description: This Java source file defines the 'CommandSource' entity class, which represents a command or action issued within the application, capturing details like action name, associated entities, timestamps, user information, status, and related identifiers. It includes annotations for persistence using JPA, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction, and methods for creating and managing command source records.

classes.name: CommandSource
classes.description: Entity class representing a command or action source with various metadata fields related to the command execution, status, and associated entities.

methods.name: fullEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates a new CommandSource instance with detailed information from a CommandWrapper and JsonCommand, including timestamp, user, and other metadata.

methods.name: getPermissionCode
methods.description: Returns a string representing the permission code based on action name and entity name.

methods.name: getStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns the current status of the command as an enum.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the command to a specified enum value.

methods.name: markAsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Marks the command as awaiting approval by setting its status accordingly.

methods.name: isAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the command is awaiting approval.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Checks if the command has been processed.

methods.name: markAsChecked
methods.description: Marks the command as checked, records the checker and timestamp, and sets status to processed.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if the command has been checked.

methods.name: markAsRejected
methods.description: Marks the command as rejected, records the checker and timestamp, and updates status.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Checks if the command has been rejected.

methods.name: updateForAudit
methods.description: Updates the command source with audit result details.
